title: TikTok Creator Metadata
description: Every field tt_creator_scrape.py writes for a scraped TikTok creator/profile (TikTokCreator.to_dict()). Null-valued optional fields are omitted from the record (exclude_none); the always-present fields are listed in `required`.

username.description: TikTok @username (uniqueId). Keys the on-disk record and the scrape queue, though a creator can rename.

sec_uid.description: Stable opaque user id (secUid); the durable identity across username changes.

user_id.description: Numeric user id (id), kept as a string to avoid precision loss.

nickname.description: Display name. Omitted from the record when absent.

signature.description: Profile bio/signature text. Omitted when absent.

avatar_thumbnail.description: Profile avatar image URL (from avatarLarger). Omitted from the record when absent.

avatar_urls.description: Profile avatar image URL variants returned by TikTok, preserving variant names such as thumb, medium, and large.

verified.description: Whether TikTok marks the account as verified.

region.description: Account region code. Omitted when absent.

language.description: Account language code. Omitted when absent.

follower_count.description: Number of followers. Read from statsV2 when present (overflow-safe), else stats.

following_count.description: Number of accounts this creator follows.

heart_count.description: Total likes/hearts across the creator's content.

videos.description: Recent public videos discovered on the creator profile, as compact ids/URLs.

reposts.description: Recent reposted videos discovered on the creator profile, as compact ids/URLs.

liked.description: Recent liked videos when the creator's liked list is public, as compact ids/URLs.

playlists.description: Playlists discovered on the creator profile, as compact playlist metadata.

scraped_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp at which this record was scraped.

playlist_ref.description: Compact reference to a TikTok playlist.

video_count.description: Number of videos in the playlist, when present.

cover_url.description: Playlist cover image URL, when present.

name.description: TikTok avatar variant key, e.g. thumb, medium, or large.

url.description: Avatar image URL for this variant.

video_ref.description: Compact reference to a TikTok video/post.

username.description: TikTok @username (uniqueId) of the account that created the video.
